data.title: 忍冬 · 地中海崖壁的黑松密谈
data.action: 倚在粗糙的石灰岩矮墙上，单手拿着意式浓缩冰咖啡轻啜，灰黑狼耳微立，另一手优雅插在腰间薄纱裙结上，目光沉稳犀利地扫视海面后转向你，带着家族领袖的威严与从容
data.location: 悬崖边生长着孤傲黑松的意式海石观景台
data.lighting: 地中海式的强烈侧光，在深橄榄绿布料上勾勒出质感
data.mood: 沉稳干练、家族领袖风范、冷峻中蕴含柔情
data.description: 地中海峭壁黑松掩映的石质观景台。忍冬身着叙拉古橄榄绿意式剪裁高叉连身泳衣，手执冰咖啡斜靠在石灰岩矮墙旁。海风扬起墨绿薄纱，她灰黑的狼耳敏锐警觉，金棕色眼眸兼具领袖的锐利与私密休假时的松弛，从容地向你举杯示意。
data.promptProse: Vulpisfoglia leans with poised authority against a sun-warmed limestone wall beneath coastal black pines overlooking the sea, wearing a sharply tailored deep olive-green high-cut monokini with brass ring buckles and a sheer charcoal-grey linen sarong. Holding a glass of iced espresso while resting her other hand at her knotted waist, she regards the viewer under crisp afternoon sidelight.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against a rough limestone cliff parapet beneath coastal black pines in a tailored olive-green high-cut monokini and sheer charcoal sarong, she lifts a glass of iced espresso with calm authority. Crisp Mediterranean afternoon sidelight traces the fabric seams against the blue sea.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sharply tailored deep olive-green high-cut monokini with brushed brass ring buckles and a sheer charcoal-grey linen sarong knotted at her hip.
